summary: Build a horizontally-scalable, multi-tenant RMM platform with cross-platform agents supporting SaaS and self-hosted deployments.

milestones.title: Phase 1: Foundation (Months 1-3)
milestones.description: Tenant/Auth service, API Gateway, PostgreSQL + TimescaleDB schema, NATS JetStream cluster, Core Agent (identity, comms, config, self-update), Basic system collector

milestones.title: Phase 2: Monitoring Core (Months 3-5)
milestones.description: Metrics ingestion pipeline (NATS → TimescaleDB), Alerting engine (threshold, heartbeat), SNMP/ICMP collector (agentless), Network Probe (SNMP, discovery), Dashboard/visualization

milestones.title: Phase 3: Remote Access & Automation (Months 5-7)
milestones.description: Tunnel infrastructure (WebSocket/NATS), RDP/SSH/VNC proxy, Script execution framework, Patch management (Windows + Linux), Software inventory + vulnerability correlation

milestones.title: Phase 4: Advanced Features (Months 7-10)
milestones.description: ML-based anomaly detection, NetFlow/sFlow ingestion, IP Phone monitoring (SIP, vendor APIs), Synthetic monitoring, Reporting engine

milestones.title: Phase 5: Platform Hardening (Months 10-12)
milestones.description: Self-hosted distribution (Helm/KOTS), Air-gapped install, Multi-region SaaS, Performance/load testing, Security audit + pentest, Documentation + runbooks
